claims.claim: Taiwan has earmarked NT$1.1 trillion ($34.5 billion) in defence spending for 2027, more than 3 percent of GDP.
claims.source_title: Taiwan's leader says increasing defence spending to 'deter war'
claims.supporting_quote: President Lai Ching-te’s government has earmarked a record NT$1.1 trillion ($34.5 billion) in defence spending for 2027, which accounts for more than 3% of GDP.
